subject: Re: Executive approval: BlueMesa Labs onboarding credit (time-bound)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: One-time onboarding credit for BlueMesa Labs

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Quick one — BlueMesa (early-stage genomics analytics) is asking for a one-time onboarding credit to cover extraordinary first-month inference spend for a 6-month pilot. Key facts:
- Account: BlueMesa Labs (contact: Elena Ruiz, Marcus Li)
- Current proposal: Starter Dedicated pool + hosted bursts; list price ~$28k/mo
- Ask: 35% credit on first 3 months (applied as invoice credit), plus waiver of onboarding surcharge ($7.5k)
- Why: Their initial eval includes long-context batches and embedding-heavy reranks; expected tokens spike in month 1 and they’re testing production-quality models (higher cost).
- Commercial signal: 12–18 month interest; legal/ procurement are willing to sign a 12-month minimal commitment if we provide the above concession.

I attached the pricing sheet, usage forecast, and a short exec memo. Commercial justification: preserves momentum for a strategic genomics pilot that could expand to dedicated capacity and multi-region deployment. Margin impact is material but recoverable if the commit converts.

Ask: I need an exec-level exception (VP/CFO) to approve a time-bound credit. Preferably a conditional approval (partial upfront credit, remainder contingent on usage). Can you review and advise path to sign-off?

Thanks — I can join a 15m to walk through.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time onboarding credit for BlueMesa Labs

Thanks Tessa — I reviewed the attachments. A few clarifying items before I take this to the approval channel:
1) Can you confirm the expected incremental gross margin impact (USD) over Q2 if we grant full 35% for months 1–3? The sheet shows conservative estimates but I want the high/low.
2) Tie the credit to a 12-month commitment (minimum ARR floor) and a usage threshold for the remaining credit. If they don’t hit threshold, remainder is forfeited.
3) Please add a short bullet (<=150 words) on strategic value / reference potential — who on their end will champion a case study?

If you can update and send a one-page executive memo, I’ll draft the approval recommendation for VP/CFO.

Also, include the HubSpot deal link in the memo so finance/legal can pull the correct SOW.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-04T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time onboarding credit for BlueMesa Labs

Marissa — updated and attached: Bluemesa_Exec_Memo_v1.pdf and updated pricing sheet. Highlights:
- Incremental gross margin impact (best/worst case): $39,600 / $22,400 over Q2 (spread shows token cost sensitivity at varying context lengths).
- Commit: BlueMesa agreed to a 12-month minimum (signed letter of intent attached to HubSpot).
- Conditional structure proposed: 15% credit applied immediately on month 1 invoice; remaining 20% released in equal parts across months 2–3 if monthly usage >= 60% of forecast.
- Strategic benefit: Pilot lead (Elena Ruiz) confirmed a potential public case study and engineering co-authored performance benchmark if pilot reaches production — adds marketing & model-onboarding validation for our long-context optimizations.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/BLM-2027-042
Attachments: BlueMesa_Pricing_Sheet_v2.xlsx, Bluemesa_Exec_Memo_v1.pdf, Usage_Forecast_Q2-Q3.csv

If this looks right I’d ask Marissa to turn this into a short recommendation and route to finance/cfo for signature.

— Tessa
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-06T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time onboarding credit for BlueMesa Labs

Folks — reviewed. I support conditional approval with the structure Tessa proposed but recommend a small change to mitigate downside:
- Approve 15% upfront credit (month 1) as proposed.
- Hold the remaining 20% in escrow against two conditions: 1) usage thresholds across months 2–3, 2) legal sign-off on data handling (they will store PHI-derived metadata in a partner vault; need SOC2 evidence).
- If legal confirms SOC2 + data handling OK, finance can release credits pro rata once thresholds are met.

Laura — can you confirm if finance/CFO are comfortable with this escrow-style release and whether we need any changes to billing terms (invoice credits vs. prepaid credit note)? Also, legal will ping with the SOC2 artifact request — suggest we thread legal on the same memo.

Jordan Blake | SVP, Sales | Redwood Inference
